import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Count and plot each transaction type for non-fraudulent and fraudulent transactions
sns.countplot(x='transaction_type', hue='is_fraud', data=data)
plt.title('Transaction Type Distribution by Fraud Status')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Fraud Status')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
